items.title: Ratification of Warrants
items.recommendation: Ratify Warrants dated: December 13, 2021, and December 20, 2021.

items.title: FY2022 General Fund and Wastewater Budget to Actual through November, 2021
items.recommendation: Receive and file the attached reports.

items.title: Re-Ratification of Local Emergency and Re-Authorizing the Use of Teleconferencing to Conduct Public Meetings
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Proclaiming a Local Emergency Persists, Re-Ratifying the Proclamation of a State of Emergency by Executive Order N-09-21, and Re- Authorizing Remote Teleconference Meetings of the Legislative Bodies of the City of Beaumont for the Period of January 6, 2022, through February 5, 2022, Pursuant to Provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act.”

items.title: Consider Adopting a Resolution Waiving the Monthly Facility Use at the Albert A. Chatigny Sr. Community Recreation Center (CRC) for Beaumont Community Youth Basketball (BCYB)
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and approve by title only, “A Resolution of the City of Beaumont authorizing the waiver of monthly facility use fees at the Albert A. Chatigny Sr. Community Recreation Center (CRC) for Beaumont Community Youth Basketball (BCYB).”

items.title: Notice of Upcoming Vacancy on the Beaumont Planning Commission
items.recommendation: Direct staff to notice the upcoming vacancy of one seat with a partial term on the Beaumont Planning Commission.

items.title: City of Beaumont Grant Policies and Procedures
items.recommendation: Approve the proposed City of Beaumont Grant Policies and Procedures.

items.title: Discussion of Beaumont Police Department Response to Calls for Illegal Fireworks and Provide Direction to City Staff
items.recommendation: Discuss and provide direction to City staff.

items.title: Direct the Beaumont Economic Development Committee to Assist Downtown Business and Landowners to Promote Business Growth and Development in the Central Business District
items.recommendation: Direct the Beaumont Economic Development Committee to assist downtown business and landowners to promote business growth and development in the central business district.

items.title: Discussion and Direction to City Staff on Comments to the Draft Initial Study/Environmental Assessment Report Prepared for the IH-10/Cherry Valley Interchange Project
items.recommendation: City Council discuss the Draft Initial Study/Environmental Assessment Report and provide direction to City staff on any comments that should be forwarded to Caltrans; City Council discuss the proposed alternative alignments and provide direction to City staff on any comments that should be forwarded to Caltrans; and Authorize Mayor Lloyd White to execute a letter conveying City Council comments to Caltrans no later than January 24, 2022.
